title: Cross-cohort seizure robustness
disposition_reason: The source now separates frozen-detector performance from analyst reconstruction. Its four-arm full CHB/Siena programme is source-available, but authentic channel/clock adjudication and observed complete execution remain missing; report reconstruction alone cannot establish transfer.

scientific_target.question: For a detector trained only on CHB-MIT people, what is its complete-Siena event performance, and how do fixed harmonization and normalization change the paired target-person outcome?
scientific_target.known_answer: Siena equal-person event F1 and paired harmonized-minus-native, normalized-minus-harmonized and harmonized-minus-timing contrasts, with mandatory sensitivity and false alarms.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Separately frozen detector streams on all 727 recordings plus private source annotations under one adjudicated clock/label profile.
scientific_target.case_unit: One complete frozen four-arm cross-cohort panel: 686 CHB and 41 Siena recordings.
scientific_target.independent_unit: 23 CHB people and 14 distinct Siena people; cross-cohort means are unpaired, within-Siena arm contrasts are paired.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Offline/transductive preprocessing transfer across age/acquisition cohorts; bundled harmonization cannot identify one causal source of the shift.
exclusions: Online detection from whole-record zero-phase filtering or median/IQR normalization
Pairing CHB people with unrelated Siena people
Neural detection competence inferred from maximum reconstruction error
Attributing cohort shift specifically to age, montage or sampling rate

inputs: Genuine EEG channels with physical calibration: CHB native 256 Hz and Siena native 512 Hz, subject to source-header verification.
Native, fixed 18-edge harmonized, whole-record median/IQR-normalized, and timing-only views defined in the source control recipe.
forbidden_inputs: Siena seizure labels for fitting or zero-calibration selection
Auxiliary channels or guessed duplicate/derived montage edges
Analyst report accuracy used as detector-quality reward
observation_contract.case_identity: Full source panel enforces 727 unique opaque prepared records, 23+14 disjoint people and 2,908 recording-by-arm outputs. Four arms are conditions within one registration.
observation_contract.split: For each arm, 23 CHB leave-one-person-out jobs provide source audit and an additional all-CHB fit predicts every Siena patient. Fit/predict phases are distinct; target prediction may jointly adapt unlabeled transient state under Q1, so this is not pointwise induction.
observation_contract.coverage: 96 logical jobs and 192 fit/predict invocations; no recording or failed arm may disappear. Corpus bytes, true montage/reference compatibility and complete observed runtime are unqualified.

primary.name: Siena_equal_person_event_f1
primary.aggregation: Per arm, pool event counts within each of 14 Siena people and average person F1; paired changes retain those same people.
primary.rationale: Directly scores the biological target; analysis_reconstruction remains a separate calibration outcome.

secondary: Siena event sensitivity and false alarms per 24 observed hours for every arm
Target paired contrasts and unpaired target-minus-source cohort shifts
Clock-profile sensitivity, complete false-alarm localization and observed support

comparators.name: Native EEG reference
comparators.inputs: Native valid EEG channels, no Siena labels
comparators.procedure: Source median-channel log-line-length method with threshold trained on CHB people; empirical competence unqualified.

comparators.name: Harmonized/normalized reference pair
comparators.inputs: Same selected detector family with fixed 18 edges and declared transforms
comparators.procedure: Source recipe bundles montage, filter and resampling; normalization additionally uses unlabeled whole-record statistics.

comparators.name: Audited timing reference
comparators.inputs: Training-person-balanced ictal prevalence by elapsed minute
comparators.procedure: Exact fixed Laplace-smoothed timing source required; arbitrary metadata programmes are a broader comparator.

nuisance_controls: Hold detector family fixed when interpreting preprocessing; otherwise call it a bundled method comparison.
Preserve PN05-3/PN14-3 clock-origin alternatives until source adjudication.
Audit unique forward/reverse CHB edges and Siena common-reference evidence before subtraction.
Retain offline/transductive status for zero-phase filters and future-dependent normalization.
evaluation.uncertainty: Within-target contrasts use paired Siena patient summaries; CHB-to-Siena shifts use independent cohort summaries, never person pairing. Current standard errors are descriptive conditional on shared fitted models and do not establish population causality.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require complete 727-record/four-arm streams and exact score-to-event transformation; missing montage edges, zero IQR, ambiguous source profiles or incomplete phase lineage invalidate the full selected comparison, not just inconvenient rows.

implementation.scorer_target: analysis.detector_outcomes computes actual frozen stream Siena_equal_person_event_f1 and companion metrics. analysis.grade separately returns maximum_scaled_reconstruction_error for the released report; score.py writes distinct outcomes.
implementation.delivered_scope: Complete scientific graph, reference/preprocessing source, target outcome calculator and reconstruction grade; authentic input/runtime qualification remains absent.
missing: Resolve native clock, common-reference and montage-source joins.
Execute the complete frozen four-arm source and target programme with observed fitting lineage.
Use detector_outcomes as scientific endpoint and keep analyst reconstruction separately labeled.
Build a target-withholding investigation condition for adaptive interpretation claims.
implementation.execution_evidence: Source inspection confirms both outcome paths; neither was executed on authentic EEG by this revision.

direct_observation.representation: Whole-cohort transfer contrasts require complete quantitative evidence; a single EEG trace is not a suitable substitute. A direct numerical-summary condition is possible but not delivered with withheld answers.
direct_observation.boundary: Only the declared observation/demonstration context, no external tools or evaluator feedback; a new direct condition needs an independently frozen view and complete output identity.
missing: No delivered participant condition establishes this mode for the same scientific target.

typed_viewer.representation: Waveform viewing can assist montage/artifact inspection but does not replace the full transfer estimand; no typed viewer condition is supplied.
typed_viewer.boundary: Only typed render/navigation actions with audited limits; no raw arrays, labels, filenames or external source retrieval returned to the participant.
missing: No delivered participant condition establishes this mode for the same scientific target.

tool_assisted.representation: Source analysis and reconstruction CLI are available; actual exploratory per-case interpretation with withheld targets remains unqualified.
tool_assisted.boundary: Same permitted observations, frozen checkpoint tools and accounted compute as the compared arm; case state and feedback policy must be fixed before query.
missing: The analysis/reconstruction CLI is operator computation; a target-withholding adaptive participant investigation condition is not delivered.

frozen_program.representation: Source phased fit/predict programme and fixed references are available for the full panel; authentic staging, host protection and execution remain unestablished.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze code and fitting/adaptation recipe before queries; admit only explicitly allowed labels/calibration, retain all failed/incomplete cases.
missing: Authentic source admission, protected runtime/environment and complete original fit/predict execution remain unqualified.
